Report: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1269

The reporter confirms current model and version probes succeed, but health still counts seven historical failures from August 22 and no recorded successes. Treat this as a reported diagnostic accounting defect; do not describe the repaired resolver itself as broken. Independent reproduction is pending.

Implementation should preserve append-only history and bounded, privacy-safe reason codes. Evaluate recording resolved outcomes or deriving genuine probe successes, and expose the measurement window so historical failures are distinguishable from current regressions.
Count successful provenance resolutions so historical health advisories can clear

GitHub #1269 reports that successful resolver events omit agent_provenance_outcomes while health counts attempts and successes only from those outcomes, leaving old zero-success warnings after resolver repairs.
Cover failed-then-resolved, genuinely all-failed, unavailable-only and incomplete or bounded-history samples; verify through real SDK mutation and health flows, not fabricated success-only history.

Use a workspace with historical failed resolver outcomes followed by successful probe-sourced model/version events. Inspect health zero-success warnings and compare successful event provenance with context.agent_provenance_outcomes.

Successful probe resolutions must contribute truthful success evidence; repaired resolvers must not retain a permanent zero-success advisory. Expose the sampled measurement window and preserve real all-failure warnings.
Reporter observes seven old failures and zero counted successes despite hundreds of newer successful probe records. Independent reproduction remains pending.
SDK provenance health and immutable outcome recording
